A stack is to be set up using the information in the table.

[[fig:f1]]

A constant, with identifier `Capacity`, limits the size of the stack to 25 items.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Write the pseudocode for the required declarations.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Complete the pseudocode function `Pop()` to pop an item from `Stack`.

```
//  popping an item from the stack

FUNCTION Pop()
    DECLARE Item : REAL
    Item ← 0

    BasePointer THEN
        Item ←
        TopPointer ←
    ELSE
        OUTPUT "The stack is empty - error"
    ENDIF

ENDFUNCTION
```

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Compare and contrast the queue and stack Abstract Data Types (ADT).

figures.alt: A three-column table lists the identifiers BasePointer, TopPointer and Stack, their data types INTEGER, INTEGER and REAL, and their descriptions.
